scoring_justification: Primary claim is Lakhno criterion inequalities; full recompute from raw integrals infeasible.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold dipole moments and critical value
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Section IV reports mu_Si-O=1.12 D, mu^0_Si-O-Si=0.17 D; Lakhno criterion mu_critical=0.318 D from reference [12].
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted from paper text and equations
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are the exact numbers the paper claims; used as reference for comparison within tolerance.

outputs.description: Computed dipole moments for the Si–O bond and the Si–O–Si bridge, together with the Lakhno critical dipole moment (0.318 D). The hidden checker compares the submitted values to paper-reported reference dipole moments within a tolerance regime and verifies the inequality µ_Si‑O > µ_critical and µ^0_Si‑O‑Si < µ_critical.

output_contract.notes: The scoring verifier compares the computed dipole moments to hidden reference values and checks the Lakhno criterion inequalities. No external datasets or model files are required; the agent implements the integrals from the publicly available Slater orbital descriptions and geometry parameters.
